summary: The P0 design is ready for approval from the independent-benchmark perspective. Product, truth, fixture, and scorer ownership are separated; the anti-customization gate is answer-blind; matcher v2 and promotion are not relaxed; the cold Range runs are explicitly in-distribution, non-formal baselines; and the formal Benchmark v5 path remains independently gated.

non_blocking_findings.title: Length-finished responses need later investigation
non_blocking_findings.evidence: The frozen cold baseline records 103 responses with finish_reason=length.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Investigate this under P2/P6 without restoring a product scan-wide token cap.

non_blocking_findings.title: Balanced baseline cost is descriptive rather than a closure result
non_blocking_findings.evidence: The balanced V3 run records approximately 13.9 million tokens without proof-kernel closure qualification.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Keep it as a frozen behavior/cost baseline only.

non_blocking_findings.title: Legacy deferred-budget terminology remains in historical evidence
non_blocking_findings.evidence: Historical summaries preserve the legacy deferred_budget label for attribution continuity.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Clean up terminology in a later product-only change while preserving historical evidence.

non_blocking_findings.title: WSL toolchain activation is not implicit
non_blocking_findings.evidence: The P0 preflight records that the non-interactive WSL PATH requires explicit activation.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Retain the explicit formal-run preflight and fail closed on missing tools or shared libraries.

non_blocking_findings.title: Exact cold-run argv was not archived
non_blocking_findings.evidence: The P0 summaries record commands and environments at summary level rather than preserving the exact argv transcript.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Archive exact invocation metadata for P6/P7 formal evidence.

non_blocking_findings.title: Black and remote CI remain unverified locally
non_blocking_findings.evidence: The evidence index records the local Black hang and the no-push constraint.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Confirm these hygiene checks before a remote merge when authorization exists.

checks.name: reviewed_commit_and_tree_identity
checks.evidence: The review was bound to commit b74e6b6e82224d487392ad7e03d794d6592a514a and tree aca131c453e2176944527a1bd3902c08d1bc3948.

checks.name: product_truth_scorer_separation
checks.evidence: ADR-0006 and the change-scope gate separate product, truth/fixture, and scorer domains and reject mixed changes.

checks.name: answer_isolation
checks.evidence: Truth is restricted to entry coverage before scanning and independent scoring after scanning; product and LLM analysis contexts exclude truth content.

checks.name: anti_customization_hygiene
checks.evidence: The hygiene gate is path/content-category based and does not require reading ground-truth identities.

checks.name: matcher_and_promotion_non_relaxation
checks.evidence: The four-TP difference is attributed to V1 uncertainty with open facts; the design explicitly forbids matcher, promotion, or Range-specific exceptions.

checks.name: range_is_in_distribution_only
checks.evidence: P0 cold runs are labelled non-formal and non-release-eligible; Range is used only as an in-distribution diagnostic.

checks.name: formal_benchmark_path_is_independent
checks.evidence: Benchmark v5, Truth v16, OCI execution, sealed/external sets, FPR terminology, and reviewer roles remain later independent gates.

limitations: No benchmark or model-backed scan was run during this review.
Range ground-truth content, GROUND_TRUTH.md, truth queues, case identities, and other reviewer outputs were not read.
Ignored aggregate artifacts were absent and were evaluated through answer-free summaries and hashes only.
Remote CI and the local Black check were not independently completed.
This approval is limited to P0 design freeze and does not make the cold baselines release-eligible.
attestation: I approve the P0 design for the independent_benchmark role at reviewed commit b74e6b6e82224d487392ad7e03d794d6592a514a and tree aca131c453e2176944527a1bd3902c08d1bc3948. I did not read Range truth content or other reviewer output, did not execute a benchmark, and made no repository edits.
